name: QA-1124-REV-01: Revising the offer after the Merchant Call sends a revised contract
description:
Objective: Revising the offer after the Merchant Call sends a revised contract.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the configured origin; authorized test account; an existing application in the needed state discovered read-only, or an unsaved intake whose writes are blocked.
Steps:
1. Follow the reproduction steps of QA-1124-REV-01.
2. Evaluate the encoded checks in `test_offer_revised_after_merchant_call_sends_the_revised_contract`.
3. Record any mismatch.
Expected: 1. Revising the offer after the Merchant Call sends a revised contract.
2. The bug's expected result holds; no unintended record or state residue.
